newsitem.title: USA: Electronic Designs granted two U.S.patents.
newsitem.headline: Electronic Designs granted two U.S.patents.

text.p: A division of Electronic Designs Inc was awarded two U.S. patents for smooth diamond films used in coated cutting tools, the company said on Thursday.
It said Crystallume, its diamond products division, was granted patents 5,571,615 and 5,571,616, which describe smooth diamond films that are either free-standing or coating a substrate.
EDI designs, manufactures and markets semiconductor memory modules and flat-panel display products.
